comment: GCN 9607 Table: 3σ UVOT finding-chart coadd; T_start=14080 s, T_stop=20350 s after trigger. Window midpoint/half-span convention; its window contains MAST per-image data with matching summed exposure (shared photons; coadd/individual limits are correlated, not exact duplicate rows); no Galactic extinction correction; UVOT Vega system per Poole+2008. Source: https://gcn.nasa.gov/circulars/9607, accessed 2026-10-30.

GCN 9614: started 2009-07-02 18:54 UT; 2×600 s SDSS r exposures; 3σ limit r>22.4. Midpoint of 20-min total exposure; no mag-system declaration in circular; left blank. Source: https://gcn.nasa.gov/circulars/9614, accessed 2026-10-30.
